answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1012 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the jade. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the vault queue while honest participants promoted earlier continues earning. The trellis index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Each copy needs 4 hours of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
